harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the four-node Prometheus/Thanos stack. Both Prometheus replicas collect all hosts, node3 provides deduplicated live and historical queries on port 10902, and node4 provides private TLS-protected object storage. Failover and sequential OS-restart recovery passed on every node.
actions_performed: Configured independent Prometheus replicas and Thanos sidecars on node1 and node2.
Enabled node-exporter on all four nodes.
Configured Thanos Query, Store Gateway, and Compactor on node3.
Configured authenticated HTTPS MinIO storage and the private `thanos-metrics` bucket on node4.
Stored protected object-store variables at `/root/thanos-objectstore.env` on node3.
Tested each Prometheus outage independently and restored full health.
Restarted node1–node4 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collecting all four hosts
evidence.summary: Both replicas are enabled, active, ready, have 4/4 healthy targets, persistent TSDB blocks, working sidecars, and zero upload failures.

evidence.requirement: Thanos Query, Store Gateway, Compactor, deduplication, and historical data
evidence.summary: All node3 services are enabled and ready; three stores are healthy, four fresh host series have no replica labels, historical results exist for both replicas, Compactor is not halted, and bucket verification passes.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store, private bucket, and required data path
evidence.summary: MinIO is active on node4, authenticated bucket access succeeds, anonymous access returns 403, nine metadata objects persist, and data resides under `/srv/thanos-objectstore`.

evidence.requirement: Object-store access variables on node3
evidence.summary: `/root/thanos-objectstore.env` exists with mode 600 and root ownership before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Queries survive node1 Prometheus outage and retain node1 history
evidence.summary: Node1 was confirmed unavailable while node3 returned four fresh deduplicated series plus node1-only historical data; node1 and all store connections then recovered.

evidence.requirement: Queries survive node2 Prometheus outage and retain node2 history
evidence.summary: Node2 was confirmed unavailable while node3 returned four fresh deduplicated series plus node2-only historical data; node2 and all store connections then recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services/data/targets, and full Thanos membership are proven.

evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services/data/targets, and full cluster health are proven.

evidence.requirement: Node3 mandatory restart sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovery of Query, Store, Compactor, membership, credentials, and historical queries are proven.

evidence.requirement: Node4 mandatory restart sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovery of MinIO, TLS, authentication, access controls, exporter, and persistent objects are proven.
